thread:
Anya: Heads-up — after yesterday's VPC egress tighten some GPU onboarding jobs in ap-southeast-1 are failing at bootstrap with 403 when hitting Vault.
Leo: seen it. start ~02:10 UTC. new nodes never fetch keystore token so they don't decrypt model shards.
Jorge: sample error: 
```
2026-05-05T02:11:03Z bootstrap: vault read failed status=403 path=secret/data/prod/keystore/node-token
message=permission denied to path
```
Anya: looks like the firewall rules blocked the service account's NAT path to the keystore proxy, but also the new vault policy narrowed allowed paths to "infra/keystore/apac/*" so legacy bootstrap looks blocked on two fronts.
Marta (compliance): important — was audit-shipper running during the change window? we need trails for the access denied events.
Leo: audit-exporter was toggled off during the VPC rollout to reduce log volume. we have a ~20m audit gap. ops-bot already raised a compliance alert.
ops-bot: Audit gap alert created: GAP-2026-05-05-VPC.
Jorge: mitigation plan: (1) open emergency exception for temporary NAT allowlist for bootstrap IPs, (2) create a Vault policy alias that maps legacy path to the new apac path for 30m, (3) re-enable audit-exporter immediately.
Anya: doing step 3 now — kubectl -n infra patch deployment audit-exporter to set EXPORTER_ENABLED=true.
Jorge: temp policy applied and secret injected into infra/bootstrap-token. nodes started to fetch tokens and join warm pool. warm capacity recovering slowly.
Marta (compliance): please document exception and include list of affected node IDs and timeline. we'll need that for regulators.
Anya: creating follow-up PLT ticket for runbook changes: add VPC rollout precheck for vault path mappings and require audit toggles to be two-person approved. closing when warm pool back to target.
